tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ tshe dpag med gnas lcags rdo rje dngos grub kun 'dus kyi dbang bskur rgyas pa'i rim pa ji ltar bya tshul ltas chog ma lags/ 2)༄༅/ gang gis mtshan tsam dran pas kyang*/ 'chi bdag bdud las rab rgyal nas/ ye shes rdo rje'i mchog stsol ba'i/ tshe dpag med la gus phyag 'tshal/ de'i dad ldan slon bu sbyin byed pa'i/ las rim bla ma'i phyag bzhes nyid/ gang yin 'dir ni bri bar bya/ ༈ de la bcom ldan tshe dpag med pa'i byin rlabs dbang bskur gyi rig 'dzin hū1 nag me 'bar gyi gter kha las byon pa'i tshe sgrub gnam lcags rdo rje dngos grub kun dbang bskur ji ltar bya tshul ltas chog nyid du 3) ston pa la/ sngon du bya ba'i las rim dang dbang bskur dngos kyi rim pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ zab chos 'di dag gi dbang lung bka' gtad yongs rdzogs thob cing skyed rdzogs brten sgrub smin grol gyi nus pa rab 'bring ci rigs thob pa'i bla ma la/ snod ldan gyi slob mas don gnyer gus pas gsol ba tab pa'i dus bzang por/ yid dang mthun bkra shis dge mtshan dang land pa'i gnas der dogs dgu'i yo byad 'dzoms par bsag la/ dkyil 'khor lta gon ni/ de yang gang zhig chos bka' yongs rdzogs kyi rgyun 'dzin bsran 'gro'i don chen nus pa'i slob ma lta bu la 'ja' tshon zab gter gyi chos skor tshang ma zhal phye ba'i don du bgyi na/ sa chog lta gon sogs nas 4) bzungs sde sgrub chen sngon 'gro'i las rim thams cad zhi khro des don snying po'i khog 'bubs khyung chen snying kha nas ji ltar 'byang ba zhin lag tu blangs te/ sgrub khang yangs sar dbus su dkyil 'khor chen mo bzhengs shing*/ de'i phyi rol gyi shar phyogs su thugs rje chen po ngag song rang grol/ ltor che dpag med dngos grub bun 'dus 'di nyid/ nub tu yid bzhin nor bu/ byang du bka' brgyad dngos grub snying po gu ru rdo rje gang rung gi dkyil 'khor bya zhing*/

de dag gi mtha' bskor bar mtshams gang rigs rnams su bka' srung sapa so'i gtor ma dbang rdzas rnams bsham la/ sgrub 'chod bsnyen pa sogs kyang gtso bor zhi khro'i khog thub kyi gzhung bsrang zhing war la dkyil 'khor tha dad pa'i cho ga dang 'dzab bston sogs skabs dag sbyar ba dang*/ dbang gi rim pa dag kyang de dang mtshungs par rim gyis bskur nas/ mthar/ sgrub chen rjes kyi las rim mtha' dag kyang khog 'bus chen che ltar baya dgos na'ang*/ 'di ni tshe sgrub nyid kho na'i dbang chog ji ltar bya thabs 'chad par phyir/ sa chog sogs rgyas par ma gsungs pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi ltegs bu ci rigs kyi 5) khar ras bris sam r+d+yal tshon gyi dkyil 'khor byed na dur khrod ni mi dgos shing gzhan 'khor yug go rdzogs spyi mthun gyi dbus su thig le lnga tshom phyogs mdog gzhan spyi mthun las nub dang dbus gnyis kha dog brjes te/ dbus dmar po/ nub sngon po'i thig le byas pa'i kun gyi mtha'i mu 'khyud 'ja' skor lnga ldan dang*/ de'i phyi nor pad+ma 'dab bzhi mdzes tshon mu 'khyud can du bya la/ gal te 'gru'i tshom bu byed pa'i tshe na/ lte bar tshom bu gzan las lnga bskur gyis tshe ba ni gtso mchog nyid dang*/ de'i phyogs bzhir gsum 'gyur tsam bzhi bgos pa ni tshe dpag med rigs bzhi yab yum/ de dag gi phyi skor du nyis 'gyur tsam bzhi dgod pa ni rigs gsum mgon po dang pad 'byung*/ de'i phyir rol zur bzhi la mgyogs ma bzhi dang*/ phyogs bzhir sgo ba yab yum rnams te brgyad po ni cung zad chung ba tsam du legs par dgod do/ dbang rdzas ni dkyil 'khor gyi steng du khris su'am cog rtse sogs kyi khar bum pa mtshan ldan kha brgyan can mgul 'chings lha'i sku mdog dang mthun pa gzungs thag rdo rje sogs spyi mthun byas pa 'jom na lnga 6) bsham pa'i kha rgyan gyi khrod du tshe dpag med rigs lnga po'i sku rten dkon mchog mi gzhugs pa dang*/

cis kyang ma 'byor na gtso gcig pur bsdu ba las gos ma mchis la/ bum rdzas lnga mtshan lnga dang dkar mngar sogs chig dang mthun par bsags pa bum chur blag nas bum pa'i gsum gnyis dgang ma/ bum pa rnams phyogs ma 'grul bar bkod/ de dag gi bar mtshams dang mtha' bskor mi rigs par lha so so'i sku rten li dang*/ thod pa bdud rtsi chang gi bkang ba/ tshe ril dpon slob thams cad kyi grangs las mi nyung ba la 'di nyid kyi tshe ril sgrub thabs nas gsungs pa'i sman rdzas rnams kyi babs rgyun dang ma ra gsum sogs btab pa dang/ tshe gtor bum gzugs rgyan gyi mdzes par byas pa me long g.yas dag rma bya'i mdongs/ 'phreng ba dmar po/ tshe'i gzungs sngags mtshal gyis bris pa lhan cig pa sogs bsham zhing*/ gzhan yang mtha' rten gyi dbang la dgos pa'i bkra shis rtags brgyad/ dngos grub kyi zas sna/ dar zab kyi gos sna/ slob bu gzhan don nus pa yin na bka' gtad yongs rdzogs bya ba'i chos skor gyi glegs bam dang*/ dbang gos 7) pad zhwa rdor dril gdugs rgyan mtshan rol cha sogs kyang 'dzim par sta gon byas la/ sleb ma phal pa ma ni mi dgos so/ khyad par tshe srog gis gta'am rten du mda' dar la gser g.yu dung chung byu ru mu men khrab byang mig dgu rnams brtags pa 'bru dkar mo phreng gang las mi nyung ba la gtsug ste dbang rdzas rnams kyi rgyab phyogs su bzhag las bum mam dung chos gang rigs dri bzang gi chus bkang ba la rdor sems bskyed bzlas byas pa dang*/ me tog cod pan 'dor ba'i yo byad dang mig dar sogs mdor na 'dir dgos pa mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par tshags su tshud par byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' bskor gang 'os su bsham zhing*/ sman rag gtor ma tshogs kyi longs spyod/ phyi nang gi mchod pa mtha' dag kyang gtsang zhing mdzes pa gya nom pa bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa dang ldan par bya ba ni sngon du bya ba'i las rim mo/

de nas slob dpon nyid dkyil 'khor dang zhal sprod du bzhugs nas mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs gnas tshogs zhing rnams lam gyi gsal btab la thun mong gi skyabs sems tshogs bsags 8) rnams spyi ltar ram/ 'di nid kyi chos spyod chen mo nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/ de nas las byang gi gzhung srang ste bdag mdun bum sogs gcig car du bskyed pa la spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag mchod bstod thams cad chig don mthun par byas pa'i mthar bzlas pa'i skabs la babs tshe/ 'dzab kyi dgongs pa'i ting 'dzin ni las byang nyid las gsungs pa bzhin/ bdag nyid gtso mchog gi thugs srog hrīḥdamar gyi mtha' bskor sngags 'phreng pad+ma rā ga'i kha dog lta bus bskor ba las 'od 'phros mdun bskyed lha tshogs kyi thugs kar phog de dag las kyang 'od zer dpag tu med pa phyogs bcug 'phros pas/ 'khor 'das snod bcud brtan g.yo kun gyi bcud dang nus pa dngas ma stob rtsal byin rlabs dngos grub tshe dpal mtha' dag bsdus nas dbang rdzas rnams la thim par dmigs shing las gzhung gi 'dzab dang tshe gzungs ring thung la bzlas pa ci 'grub bya zhing*/ nyin tshan thun bzhi 'am gsum spos dang rol mo mda' dar sogs 'thogs nas tshe 'gugs myur 'phyogs lcags kyi dbu nas bzungs 9) te/ bkra shis dpal 'bar byin phob cing*/ ces pa yan chad kyi tshe dpal bkug bstims la 'bad/ tshogs mchod dang chos srung la gtor 'bul bskangs gso la yang nan tan du bya ba dang*/ 'dzab kyi thun mtshams su dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po yang ci rigs bzlas pas kha gso zhing ngar 'dogs pa ste/ de lta bu'i tshe sgrub zhag grangs ci tsam mang zhing byin rlabs che bas na/ yul dus gang zag dang bstun la bsgrub par bya'o/ gal te de tsam du bsgrub pa'i long med pa'i tshe na'ang cho ga'i rim pa gong du rmon pa 'di dag cha tshang bar tshar gcig dang*/ bzlas pa yang stong phag sogs gang 'grub ci nas kyang byas la/

de nas dbang bskur bya ba'i skabs la nam bab pa'i sngon du/ las byang gi mjug tu yod pa'i tshe lha rnams la thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba de nyid byas pa'i mthar/ mdun rkyed lha tshogs thams cad kyi gnas gsum 'gru gsum thugs srog dang bcas pa'i 'od zer bdag la phog pa tsam gyis sgrib bzhi dag cing dbang bzhi thob/ lha rnams kyi phyag gi bum pa nas 'chi med ba'i bdud rtsi 10) rgyun skad mda' ltar byung ste bdag nyid kyi tshangs bum tu zhugs nas lus thams cad rgyal ltar khengs las 'chi med kyi tshe dang 'khor 'das kyi dpal yon thams cad yongs su 'phel rgyas zad med du gyur par mos la 'dzab bzla zhing 'khor sum yongs dag chen por bstan mar 'jogs pa ni slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang chen/ ༈ de nas slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi rim pa dngos la'ang 'di nyid dbang gzhung las gsungs pa'i thog mar slob mas bla ma nyid la dbang gis snyen grub cha 'jug par zhu pa dang*/ dam tshig bsrel sgrub kha gi sgo drung nas sgo drung la gsol ba gdab pa sogs gsungs gzhi dbang sgrub chen mo'i skabs kho na la dmigs nas dkyil 'khor phyi 'jug na/ jug tha dad kyi rim pa rgyas pa la dgongs par gda' na'ang*/ skabs 'dir ni nang 'jug 'ba' zhig la bsku phyir gong ma de dag mi 'tshal bas na/ slob ma rnams dang dkyil 'khor gyi bar mtshams yol bas bcad nas/ slob mas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal yul zhing*/ slob dpon gyis kyang bgegs bskrad srung 'khor khrus tshag sogs spyi gzhung ltar rgyas bsdus gang 'tshams byas pa'i rjes la 11) zab mo'i chos 'chad pa ni/ ༈ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba thams cad 'khor ba thog ma med nas pha ma drin can du ma gyur pa gang yang med pas/ de dag thams cad myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub rin po che la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos gsan snyam pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa byang chub sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i ngang nas legs par gsan 'tshal rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang dam pa'i chos ni 'jig rten du 'byung ba dkon zhing brnyed pa rab tu dka' la/

dal 'byor skyor med thob cing dbang po sgo lnga tshang nas dam pa'i chos dang phrad pa ni de bas kyang ches cher dka' ba lags pas/ da lta phun tshogs rten 'brel 'dzom zhing rang dbang thob pa'i dus 'dir nam zhag gtan mdun bsgrub par shin tu ran la ran par ma zad phyis pa la thug lar nye ste 12)ci'i phyir na/ nam 'chi'i nges pa ni spu tsam med la shi khar phan nges kyi lha chos la gongs dang goms pa ni ma thob/ gdengs med du 'chi ba'i 'gro pa ni 'khor ba dang ma gtogs med/ ngan 'gror skyes nas ni bskal pa nas bskal pa'i bar du thar pa'i dus min 'byung la/ de tshe 'gyod kyang phan thabs rdul tsam med tshe ci bya tol med mdun ma gtan rlag tu song ba yin pas/ de bas da lta thabs dang long glag yod dus phyi ma'i don chen thar pa byang chub bsgrub pa la ci myur ci lcogs su 'bad dgos/ le lo snyoms las sang bya snang bya'i ngang la mi tshe rmi lam gyi snang ba tsam 'di yud kyi zad nas yong snyam med med pa'i 'chi ba de nam mkha'i thog ltar btsan phog tu 'byung bar yid la legs par bsol mdzod la/ sgo gsum dkar po dge ba'i phyogs su 13)brtson pa chen pos rems shing 'bad nas 'chi ba'i dus byung tsa na ngan pa'i blo sna phyi la ma lus pa zhig dgos pa lags/ khyad par 'o skol 'dzam gling pa'i mi la tshe'i grangs tshad med cing na so la ltos pa med par nges med du 'chi/ yang sgos dang dus bskal pa'i tha ma tshe me sum cu kha ral gyi mthar thug la sleb pa dus min blo bur du 'chi ba kho na mang la/ de la phan ru re bas kun rdzob kyi bon rtsis gsum la brten pa'i rim gro'i rnam grangs ji tsam byas rung tshe la 'thud du med cing 'chi ba la bshol du med par 'gro dgos la/ rim gro de dag gi ched du srog chags gsod pa la sogs sdig pa'i bye brag ci dang ci byas pa'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bus slar la tshe'i bar chad dang phyi ma'i ngan song gi gting rdor 'gyur phyir/

de bas na 'chi bdag gi 'jigs 14)chen de las skyobs cing phan pa'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa ni bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam shes gzi brjid kyi rgyal po nyid la brten dgos te/ de ni byang chub mchog tu thugs skyed pa'i dus nas brtsams te/ gang zhig bdag gis mtshan tsam rna bar thos pas kyang dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las yongs su thar bar gyur cig ces pa la sogs kyi smon lam chen po brgya phrag btab { bde ba can zhing bkod kyi med nas gsungs pa'o/ }pa'i bden stobs dang byin rlabs kyi nus pa'i khyad par yin pa'i phyir/ de nyid kyi mtshan tsam thos pas dus min 'chi bzlog par 'gyur na/ de'i dbang dang byin rlabs smin grol gyi gdams pa thob cing nyams su len pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ dpe na tshe dpag med pa'i rgyud dang mdo gzungs dbang dang sgrub thabs ji snyed zhig mchis pa las/ skabs 15)la bab pa 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus mod tsam brjod pa'i dbang du bgyi na/ nges pa'i don du rgyal ba thams cad chos sku mnyam pa chen por tha mi dad na'ang*/ gdul bya drang don gyi snang tshul tsam du/ mi mjed kyi zhing khams 'di nas nub phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'das pa'i pha rol na/ zhing khams rin po che bde ba can zhes bya ba yod de/ snod bcud mtha' dag ye shes rang byung gi bkod pa 'ba' zhig las/ ma dag 'khrul pa a 'thas las snang gi sa rdo ri brag khang khyim sogs kun rdzob 'dus byas 'byung bzhi'i rgyu rkyen las ma grub par ye shes 'od lnga'i zhing dang gzhal yas rgya khyon ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa dang yin tan ni rang cag so so skye bo'i blos dpag cing bsam par yang mi nus na ngag tu brjod pa lta ga la nus shing*/ zhing der gnas pa'i gang zag kyang pa chen po 16)la bzhugs pa'i byang sems 'phags pa sha stag ma gtogs sgrib par ldan pa phal pa'i skye 'gro'i rigs ni sgra yang mi grags la/

de'i bdang gis nyon mongs pa dang mya ngan dang sdug bsngal dang 'thab 'khrug mi dge ngan 'gro sogs kyi ming tsam yang mi srid pa'i phyir na bde ba can gyi zhing zhes bya ba ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi spyod yul kho na las gzhan ma yin no/ de lta bu'i zhing gi ston pa ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa tshe mtha' yas pa ye shes snang ba'i 'od zer mthu rgyas pa'i dbang po ces bya ba ste/ 'o skol gyi ston pa dpal kun tu bzang po'am/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid kyi sku mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rnam 'gyur yin zhing*/ de'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang nyid las kyang gzhan ma yin pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems mtshan dang rnam 'gyur bsam 17)yas bstan yang nyid kyi yon tan mi zad pa'i rol pa 'ba' zhig las/ gdul bya dang 'dul byed mchog dman tha dad pa tshogs pa ni ma yin pas na chos kyi dbyings zab mo rgya chad phyogs lhung med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor las g.yo ba med par rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lo mor bzhugs so/ de lta bu zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi klong nas phyogs ris med pa'i thugs rje'i rlabs g.yos te/ spyir khams gsum gyi sems can las nyon gyi rgya mtshor thog mtha' bar med du bying ba rnams dang*/ khyad par mi mjed gling gzhi'i 'jig rten las kyang 'dzam gling las kyi sa rnams bskal pa rtsod ldan gyi dus la babs pa'i dbang gis tshe dang gzugs dang bsod nams longs spyod rnam rim gyis 'grib cing nyon mongs las ngan gyi rgyu rkyen je 'phel du gyur sa'i 'thus/ blo bur gyi rkyen ngan 18)sna tshogs pas bskyod de dus min du 'chi zhing shi ba rnams ngan 'gro ngan song log par ltung bas 'og nas 'og tu 'gro ba'i nyams thag gi sems rnams la dmigs med thugs rje chen pos nye bar dongs te/

nyid kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi gong bu gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte bar yi ge hrīḥyis mtshan pa zhig spros nas/ u rgyan dha na ko ṣa'i nub byag klu rdzing phug gi mtsho la thim pas me tog pad+ma stong ldan gyi sdong po khri 'phangs bdun brtsegs kyi dbus nas gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas mngal skyon dri mas ma gos shing mtshan dpe ngo mtshar gyi phung por sku 'khrungs/ rgyal po spyan med 'byor ldan gyis sras kyi skal bar mtho lcog dgu ldan gyi pho brang du spyan drangs nas lo lnga'i bar du chos kyi rgyal srid bskyangs shing yul khams bde dge la bkod/ slar yang rgyal srid 19)spangs te rgya gar gyi yul gling phyogs mtshams mtha' dbus kun tu zhabs kyi bcags shing thos bsam sgomadang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gang la cis 'dul gyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i sgron me gcig pu sar gyur pa nas/ gu ru nyid mgon po 'dog med kyi thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul la skye 'che'i 'jigs pa ye nas bral mod kyang*/ thun mong gi gdul bya nges shes bskyod phyir ri bo po ta la'i lho phyogs kyi gnas chen rā ga ra ri'i brag phug ma ra ri ka'am zla gam dbang gi phug tu lha lcam man da ra ba sgrub rten du mdzad nas 'chi med rig 'dzin gyi sgrub pa la bzhugs pas/ mgon po tshe dpag med kyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis zhal mngon sum du bstan cing dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs su bskur te tshe'i gdams pa rgyud lung man ngag thams cad kyi bka' gtad cing byin gyis 20)brlabs nas tshe'i lha tshogs rnams kyang gu ru yab yum la gnyis med du thim pas yab yum gnyis ka 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku grub nas/ man+da ra ba la yang rgya gar gyi yul khams rnams su ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mor mtshan grags/ slob dpon nyid kyis dus te shig po sa gling gi dur khrod chen por tshe dpag med pa zhal mjal nas 'chi med kyi rgyud dag gdams pa rnams gdul bya skal ldan gyi rigs la rgya cher ston zhig pa'i rjes su gnang ba thob/

slar yang g.ya' ri gong gi brag phug tu bzhugs pa'i skabs su mgon po tshe dpag med pas dngos su lung bstan nas bod yul kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su log 'dren gdug pa'i 'dre srin 'dul zhing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgron me sbar phyir bdag gis thugs las khyod sprul pa yin pas da ni de'i dus la babs po ces bskul zhing*/ 21)de dang mthun par 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis kyang yang yang du bskul bar mdzad pa'i mthus rgya gar dang bal yul gyi gdul bya rnams btul nas bod kyi phyogs su byon pa dang*/ bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde btsan la mkhan po zhi ba 'tshos lung bstan pa bsam yas kyi sa 'dul la spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya brdzangs pa dang mang yul gung thang du mjal bas lam du bod kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dul zhing bsam yas su byon te/ gtsug lag khang gi sa 'dul rab gnas mnga' gsol gyi bar du mthar phyir par mdzod/ lo tsā ba brgya dang rtsa brgyad sogs dge 'dun gyi sde dang bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rgya cher btsugs te bod yul mtha' khob mun pa'i gling kun mdo sngags dam chos kyi nyi 'od gsal ba'i bka' drin ni sus kyang 'khor bar ga la 22)nus/ de dag gi skabs shig tu chos rgyal nyid kyis gsol ba gtab pa dang gu ru rin po ches kyang rgyal po'i sku tshe nyi zla dang mnyam rgyal srid chos khrims la 'pho 'gyur med tshe bod khams kyi bde skyid nyams pa med pa la gcig tu dgongs te/ brag dmar g.ya' ba lung du tshe'i sgrub pa zhag bdun mdzad pas dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi nam mkhar tshe'i lha tshogs dngos su byon pa bum nang du thim pa de nyid rgyal po la dbang bskur ba bzhed kyang*/ sdig blon ngan pas snyan phrang gsol bas rgyal po nyid kyang the tshom gyi blo skyes nas dbang gi snod du ma gyur pas/ slob dpon gyis 'chi med tshe chu rnams ma 'ong snyigs ma'i sems can gyi don la dgongs nas gter gnas so sor gter du sbas/

slar rgyal po nyid shin tu 'gyod te mthol bshags dang zhu 'bul nan tan du bgyis nas tshe bsring bar gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ bsam yas āt+ya 23)pā lo'i gling du tshe'i sgrub pa nas chos rgyal dang ye shes mtsho r+yagal gnyis la tshe dbang gnang bas/ mtsho rgyal 'chi med kyi dngos grub thob kyang dgung lo bcu gsum gyi ring du bsring bar gyur/ slad du gu ru rin po che nyid lho nub srin yul du 'byon la nye ba na/ mchims phu brag dmar dge gong du tshe sgrub gnam lcags rdo rje dngos grub kun 'dus kyi chos skor 'di nyid kyi sgo nas myang ban ting 'dzin bzang po dang mtsho rgyal gnyis la dbang dang gdams pa ma lus yongs su rdzogs par gnang nas/ myang ban khyod tshe 'dir dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams len mthar phyin te lnga phung zag med 'od lus su grol bar 'gyur bas tshe'i sgrub pa la ltos mi 'tshal kyang*/ 24)dus ma 'ong snyigs ma rtsod ldan mthar thug pa'i dus ngan la spyod pa'i skye 'gro sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba rnams khyod kyi sprul pas 'dul ba'i dus der zab chos 'di dag dang 'phrad nas 'gro la phan pa rgya cher 'byug bar 'gyur bas zab mo'i gter du sbos shig ces sogs lung bstan bka' gtad byin rlabs mdzad cing myang ban chen pos kyang de dang mthun pa'i bden tshig smon lam rgya cher btab nas/ chos skor rnams gter shog la bkod cing gu ru nyid kyis rab tu gnas par mdzad pa dang lhan cig gter rdzas khyad 'phags mang po dang bcas te gter du sba ba'i gnas ni/ spyir 'od yul gyis sa gzhi khab rtse gang tsam yang gu rus zhabs kyis ma bcag pa ni med na'ang*/ khyad par 'phags pa'i sgrub gnas su byin gyis brlabs pa'i yongs grags kyi gnas 25)chen bzhi dang*/ bye brag tu/ lung lnga/ gling gcig rdzongs gsum/ gangs chen nyi shu dang bcas pa gsungs pa'i lung lnga'i nang tshan gyi/

shar ljon pa lug gi gnas sgo 'dzeng 'phran sgo btsug brag la gter du sbas shing*/ dam can skyes bu chen po gter srung du bkos/ de nas gu ru nyid srin po'i kha gnon la gshegs pa'i shul du myang ban gyis rdzogs chen snying tig gi dgongs pa mngon du gyur pas phyi rol la phan phyir rdzogs pa chen po'i gdams pa snyan rgyud rnams ni sbas blo gros dbang phyug sogs snod ldan dag la smra 'khrid du bstan man ngag don gyi snying po rnams yi ger btab cing gter du btams nas skal ldan dang phrad par smon lam btab nas bzhag ste/ dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'i thog tu lus zag med 'od phung du yal zhing*/ thugs rje'i sprul pa ni rgyun 26)chad med par byon pa las/ 'o skol snyigs mtha'i gdul bya skabs bral mgon med rnams kyi skyabs gnas su mtshungs bral 'ja' tshon snying po'am/ sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag me 'bar du mtshan 'chang ba'i mkhyen rtse nus gsum gyi bdag nyid dam par byon nas lung byang dus rtags dang mthun par nyang lung mdzeng 'phrang gi gter gnas de nyid nas tshe'i gdams pa rgyu dang man ngag yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ sku rten ngo mtshar can du ma dang*/ gu ru'i sgrub rdzas rdo rje phur bu/ tshe bum tshe chu dang bcas pa khrom gter du gdan drangs nas gdul bya ngo mtshar gyi gnas la bkod cing zab chos tshe chu dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang bka' bab skyes chen dag gi sku tshe bsring ba dang*/ mos ldan gdul bya rnams dus min 'chi ba'i bar chad las skyob par mdzad pa'i bka' drin ni bsam rjod 27)yul las 'das la/ 'gro don gyis kyang rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab pa mngon sum tshad mar gyur pa 'di lags mod kyi/ de'i phyir na deng gi skabs 'dir yang gdams pa zab mo 'di lta bu'i dbang bskur zhu bar byed pa la dad pa 'gyur med kyis gsol ba btab cing gang srung sgrub nus kyi dam tshig la gnas dgos pa ni slob ma'i mtshan nyid kyi rtsa ba gal po che yin pas na/

bdag rdo rje slob dpon la mi gzugs phal pa'i snang ba ma mdzad par/ mgon po tshe dpag med kyi thugs rje'i gzugs snang du mos pa rtse gcig pa'i dag snang cher skyed nas gsol ba gdab pa'i tshig 'di'i rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ kye ma/ bdag sogs ma rig sems can la/ dus min 'chi bas bar gcod na/ bla ma dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso/ bdag la thugs rjes byin rlobs 'tshal/ de ltar gsol 28)ba btab pa'i bu la bla ma tshe dpag med pas mkhyen brtse'i sgo phyos te bka'i gnang ba sbyin pa la yid rangs pas gsan 'tshal/ nyon cig las can bu rnams kun/ dkyil 'khor 'di nid mthong tsam gyis/ las ngan dag cing tshe dbang thob/ gsang sngags zab mo'i khyad chos yin/ yis la bzungs shig sa ma yā/ de ltar dbang bskur zab mo thob par byed pa la yang slob ma'i rgyud dag cing snod du rung dgos/ rgyud ma dag cing snod du ma gyur pa la dbang bskur kyang thob par mi 'gyur zhing snod min la gsang sngags bstan na slob dpon bdag nyid la yang ltung ba'i nyes sgrib 'byung phyir slob ma'i rgyud sbyang dgos pa na/ de'i thabs su nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi snod rung du byed pa skyabs 'gro/ theg pa chen po'i lam du chud par byed pa sems bskyed/ rdo rje theg pa'i gral du gzhug phyir sdom pa 29)bzung ba dang bcas pa med thabs ma mchis la/ de dag blang ba'i yul ni bla med rdo rje theg pa'i skabs 'dir bla ma ni dkon mchog ma lus pa'i bdag nyid dem 'byung gnas sems gtso bo'am khyab bdag yin pas na ji skad du bla ma sangs rgyas ma chos/ de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ zhes pa ltar rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi rang bzhin nyid phyi ltar dkon mchog gsum/ nang ltar rtsa ba gsum/ gsang bar sku gsum mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs pa'i ngo bo la rang bzhin mkhyab rdzogs byang gi go 'phang bsgrub slad 'ba' zhig la gcig tu blo nges par skyabs sems sdom bzung rnams zhu ba'i 'dun pa tshig don mthun par bdag gis rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/

e ma/ phyigs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dang*/ bla ma yi 30)dam mkha' 'gro dgongs/ rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas dang*/ zhi ba chags bral dam pa'i chos/ tshogs mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la/ bdag ni gsus pas skyabs su mchi/ byin rlabs rtsa ba bla ma dang*/ dngos grub rtsa ba yi dam lha/ phrin las mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro la/ byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ skyabs gnas kun gyi spyan snga ru/ sgo gsum gus pas gzhan don du/ gnod pa las zlog dge ba sgrubs/ dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong sogs/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa la/ rgyun du gnas shing dga' ba bsgom/ sdom pa yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ ༈ skyabs gnas thams cad dgongs su gsol/ 'di bzung byang chub ma thob par/ 'gro drug sems can thams cad la/ pha ma bu yis 'du shes kyis/ ma bsgral bsgral dang ma grol grol/ dbugs dbyung mya ngan 'das la 'god/ smon pa'i 31)byang chub sems skyed do/ sngon gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyang*/ sdom pa nal ni gnas pa ltar/ 'di gzungs 'khor ba ma stongs bar/ bla med 'jug pa'i byang chub sems/ de bzhin bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ phan phyin drug la slob cing sgrubs/ brtson grus bdag gis thams cad bsgral/ kun don tshul khrims gsum yang bzung*/ bdag gis sems skyed sdom pa bzung*/ bdag dang mthu rgyas sems can rnams/ ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du/ byang chub mchog tu sems skyed do/ na mo dkon mchog gsum ni mi spong bzhin/ rtsa gsum bla ma yi spong ngo*/ rdo rje rigs kyi dem tshig tu/ rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dang*/ rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig rnams/ rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ pad+ma rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ theg pa gsum dang chos 32)rnams bshad/ las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ 'gro ba'i don la brtson par bya/ rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig rnams/ ma lus dag gi yongs bzung ngo*/

༈ de lta bu'i sdom pa dang dam tshig spyi dang khyad par ma lus pa legs par thob pas gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du lhug cing mthong ba'i snod dang skal ba can du bsgrubs pa yin la/ 'on kyang khyed cag gis tshul 'di lta bu'i snod du ma gyur pa dang dkyil 'khor chen po 'di ma mthong ba dag gi rna bar ma brjod cig gal te de las 'da' zhing snod smin la smra bar byed na khyed bar chad kyi dbang du gyur nas tshe'i dus byed cing na raka dmyal ba'i gnad su lhung bar gdon mi za bas dam tshig thub par srungs shig sa ma yā/

zhes brjod pa'i 'phror/ rdo rje slob ma'i snying khar bzhag la/ hrīḥ 'di no bla med che yi bdag khyod kyi snying gar bstim pa yis/ 33)gal te gzhan la bshad pa na/ de ma thag tu drol te gshegs/ badz+ra sa ma ya āḥhūm̐/ las bum mam dung chos kyi chu lce la bzhag cing*/ hrīḥ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu/ dam tshig srung na dngos grub thob/ dam tshig nyams na dmyal bar ltung*/ de phyir bdud rtsi'i chu 'di 'grub/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka ṭhā/ ༈ 'di ltar rdo rje sems dpa' dang dam tshig bdud rtsi'i mna' chur bcas pa khyed la byin zhing snying la bstim pa'i mthus/ khyed cag dam tshig ma nyams par thub na 'chi med ye shes sems dpa'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs pas mchog mthun gyi dngos grub tshogs med du thob par 'gyur ba dang*/ dam las 'da' na rdo rje bdud rtsi lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgu par gyur nas snying khrag gzhib cing mnar med pa'i dmyal ba chen por bsreg par 'gyur ba ste/ des na tshul 34)'di dam tshig la gnas kyi spyan pa dang dbang po'i legs gnyis kyi stangs gcod srung ma dang khrims bdag lta bu yin pa go bar byos shig slar yang rdo rje slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag cing*/ 'o rigs kyi bu/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi rdo rje'i slob dpon nga yin pas/ nga yi ci bsgom de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ de las 'das na khyod 'chi ba'i dus byas nas rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'gro bar gdon mi za bas/ des na dam tshig tshul bzhin srung shig sa ma yā/ de nas se ras dmar po'i spyan dar bcing ba dang lhan gcig sngags 'di brjod de/ oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha wa ra ma na ye swā hā/ mig dar 'di bzhin bcings pa'i dgos pa gang yin snyam na/ 'o skol rnams 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas rang byung ye shes don gyi dkyil 'khor rang la dbyer med lhun grub tu bzhugs kyang*/ lhan skyes kyi sgrib pas 'bral med du 'thums te ma mthong ba'i tshul 'di lta bu

35)yin no/ zhes pa'i brda dang dpe mtshon pa'i phyir yin no/ da ni mchog gi dkyil 'khor dam pa mngon sum du mthong ba'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor 'di nyid kyi phyogs bzhi'i tshad med rnam bzhi'i sgo ma la gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad 'tshal/ hrīḥ dkyil 'khor shar sgo'i lha mo lcags kyu ma/ zhi ba'i las mdzad skal ldan lha dang sprod/ dkyil 'khor lho sgo'i lha mo zhags pa ma/ rgyas pa'i las mdzad skal ldan lha dang sprod/ dkyil 'khor nub sgo'i lha mo lcags sgrogs ma/ dbang gi las mdzad skal ldan lha dang sprod/ dkyil 'khor byang sgo'i lha dril bu ma/ drag po'i las mdzad skal ldan lha dang sprod/ me tog cod paṇa slob ma'i lag tu gtad nas thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung du bcug la/ de lta bus sgo ma la gsol ba btab pas sprul pa'i sgo ma rnams kyis tshe'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyogs bzhi sgo bzi phyes nas 36)khyod rang rnams kyi bar 'khyams su sleb pa'i mos 'dun mdzad pa dang*/ zhes pa'i skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi yol ba zhing*/ me tog 'di nyid phyag rten gyi tshul du dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma gus pas phul bas/ rang nyid tshe rabs sngo nas yi dam lha mchog gang la brten cing 'brel ba yod pa'i rigs de nyid dang rjes su mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha des me tog bzhes shing phyin gyis rlobs yar gyur rig snyam pa'i mos gus bskyed pa'i ngang nas tshig 'di rjes zlos gnang ba'i mthar/ bdag gi dril bu'i sgra byung ma thag me tog dkyil 'khor la 'thor ba mdzod/ hrīḥ tshe yi dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i pho brang 'dir/ las kyi 'brel ba'i me tog 'di dor na/ sngon nas las 'phro gang yod lha de la/ 'bul lo yi dam lha dang mjal bar shog oṃ su ru ṣā ya hoḥ zhes pas dril bu bsil zhing dar zab las sgrub pa'i cod paṇa rnam kyang ma 'byor pa'am slob ma ha cang mang nas ma

37) shom na bsgru'i me tog sel las kyang rung ba dkyil 'khor gyi dbus gtso bo la gtad de dor ba phyogs gang la babs pa slob dpon nam las slob kyi brtab cing re re nas ngos bzung la brjod de/ 'dir ltar me tog cod pan gang la babs pa de nyid la tshe rabs kyi lha skal zhes bya ste/ yi dam gzhan gang dang gang bsgrub pa las kyang lha skal gang yin de sgrub thag nye zhing dngos grub myur ba yin la/ de yang me tog dbus kyi gtso mchog la babs pa na mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan zhing*/ tshe'i dkyil 'khor 'di nid pad+ma gsung gi rigs gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang gis tshe rabs kyi lha skal yang pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs bsgrub par bsngags pa dang*/ dbang gis gsang mtshan du rigs 'dus pad+ma tshe dbang rtsal/ zhes thogs pa hayin pas ma brjed par 'dzin par zhu/ ༈ me tog shar du babs na rdo rje rigs kyi lha bsgrub na 38)'grub nye zhing zhi ba'i phrin las la dbang ba yin pas gsang ba'i mtshan yang rdo rje tshe dbang rtsal du 'dzin pa dang*/ lho phyogs su babs na yon tan rin chen rigs kyi lha 'grub cing rgyas pa'i rgyas pa'i phrin las la dbang bas na rat+na tshe dbang rtsal du gsang btsan 'dzin pa dang*/ nub tu babs na bde gshegs sku'i rigs 'grub cing dbang gis phrin las la mnga' brnyes par 'gyur la/ gsang mtshan ni bud+dha tshe dbang rtsal du 'dzin pa dang*/ byang du babs na las kyi rigs kyi lha 'grub sla zhing mngon spyod drag po'i dngos grub la dbang bar 'gyur bas na karma tshe dbang rtsal zhes 'thogs pa ste de'i phyir slar yang me tog gi cod pan khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bcings shing dbang gi gsang mtshan btang pa'i byin rlabs phan yon gyis/ gnas skabs su yang bdud kyi bar chad las skyob cing rigs de dang de'i yi dam 39)lhas rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur la/ mthar thug tu'ang da lta'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs gang la babs pa dag mthun pa'i zhing khams su gsang mtshan dang rjes su mtshungs pa'i mtshan don dang ldan par 'tshang rgya ba dang*/

sprul pa'i 'gro don mdzad tshul yang da lta'i las gzhi'i bka' babs gang yin dang cha mthun pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don rlabs po che spyod par 'gyur ba ste/ mdor na me tog 'dor ba'i sgo nas lha dang rigs nges par byed pa 'di ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i thabs kyi khyad chos lags pas dgongs pa 'tshal lo/ zhes cod paṇa slob ma'i spyi bor dbang bskur zhing*/ sngags 'chang dang rnal 'byor spyod pa'i cha byad can dag la ni cos pan de nyid skra'i seb tu 'bral med bcang dgos la/ 'on te rab byung gi chas can nam/ me tog sil ma gtor ba yin na/ slob dpon gyi me tog la rten 'brel snying po bzlas la cung zad re spyi bor blug par bya ste/ 'di 40)ma dbang la lar/ dbang la lnga ba cod paṇa ming gis dbang zhes bya'o/ de nas bla ma tshe dpag med pa'i thugs rje'i 'od zer mig thur lta bu 'phros pas khyod rang rnams kyi ma rig rmongs mun bag chags sgrib g.yogs thams cad bsal nas ye shes dag pa'i spyan mngon par phyes pa'i mos pa mdzod cig hrīḥ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ 'jig rten legs thog gsal ba ltar/ de ni bu khyod ma tig nad rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyi bsal/ ye shes spyan du dbye bar bya/ oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣu phyes/ pūt+ya tsan+d+ra swā hā/ zhes pas spyan dar dkrol nas/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ dkyil 'khor chen po 'di la ltos/ da ni dad pa rab tu skyed/ mthong ba tsam gyis grol ba ni/ lhun grub dkyil 'khor 'di yin no/ 'chi med rdo rje'i dngos grub thob/ khyed ni skal bar ldan pa yin/ de yang dkyil 'khor la dbye na bzhi ste/ phyi 41)snod bcud rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor/ nang 'byung khams phung po'i dkyil 'khor/ gsang ba rang rig ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor/ thun mong brda brtags gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor dang bzhi yod la/ bsdu na/ mchon byed dpe'i dkyil 'khor dang mtshon bya don gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis la 'du bas na mtshon parai ya ba'i don ngo sprod par byed pa la mtshon byed dpe la ltos dgos phyir des na gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor 'di ni/

dbus su rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa chos nyid kyi sku las longs spyod rdzogs pa kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor tshe bdag rgyal ba rigs bzhi yab yum dang*/ 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs phyag 42)rdor pad 'byung ste rnam par sprul pa'i sku bzhi/ tshe'i pho nya 'gyogs byed kyi lha mo bzhi/ sgo bzhi srung ba'i khro chen rnam bzhi rang rigs kyi yab yum dang bcas pa ste 'ace med tshe'i lha gtso 'khor nyer drug dang*/ phyi'i 'khor yug tu tshe la dbang ba'i drang srong rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprul pa yang sprul bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi bskor nas bzhugs pa rnams kyi zhal mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa dang dag snang mdzad 'tshal zhing*/ 'di ltar bu'i gsang sngags zab mo'i dkyil 'khor lan gcig mjal ba tsam gyis bskal pa grangs med pa'i sdig sgrib las nyon gyi phung po ri rab tsam yang byang bar 'gyur na/ zhugs cing dbang bskur thob pa dang bgom zhing bsnyen sgrub bgyis pa ni smos kyang ci dgos te/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 43)don chen bla na med pa grub par 'gyur bas na spro ba dang dga' brgyad chen po skyed mdzod/ ༈ 'dor na 'di yan chod kyi las rim rnams ni khyed cag rnams dbang gis snod rung du bsgrub pa'i sta gon yin te/ ji ltar 'jig rten na rin chen gser dngul la sogs las bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten sogs bya bar 'dod na dang por rgyu de dag bzhu 'dul g.ya' 'don sogs dri ma sbyong zhing las su rung bar bya ba'i thabs ji snyed cig nan tan du 'bad nas rgyu de dag mnyen zhing lhad med las rung du nam gyur pa'i tshe sku gzugs sogs gang 'dod byar rung ba'i dpe de bzhin du/ 'dir yang slob ma'i rgyud kyi bag chags sgrib tshogs rnams sbyong zhing dbang don gyi ye shes skye ba'i rgyu dang snod dang yul du rung bar sgrub nas/

༈ da ni dbang dngos gzhi la 'jug par byed pa la yang 44)gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dbang ni seng ge'i 'o ma dang 'dra ste/ de blug pa'i snod rin chen gser dngul ma gtogs snod phal pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa bzhin/ slob ma yid dam lha'i skyed rim dang mi ldan pa la bskur du mi rung bas/ des na khyed rang rang rnams yid gzhan du ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di ltar sgom par zhu/ ༈ oṃ swā bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba bharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3ham̐/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad gdod ma nas ye stong mtha' bral gyi rang bzhin nyid du lhun gyis grub pa'i gsal mdangs 'gag med kyi snang char/ 'o skol gnas pa'i yul dang khang khyim 'di dag thams cad 'jig rten kun brtag gi gnas khang du ma sems par pad+mo bde brtsan gyi zhing khams rgyan dang bkod pa ngo mtshar mthu rgyas pa'i ye shes sprul pa'i pho brang yin par mos pa mdzad/ bdag rdo rje slob dpon yang 45)mgon po 'dog med pa'i sku'i bkod pa kho na nyid du nges shes rtse gcig bskyod pa'i ngang nas/ khyod rang rnams kyi gdug pa'i stan yang me tog pad+ma mar po 'dab ma stong ldan gyi steng du zla ba nya gang ba'i gdan du gyur pa'i bus su khyed rnams kyi shes rig gi ngo bo yi ge hrīḥdamar po gcig tu gyur te/ de las 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa steng 'og phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten kun tu 'phros pas/ rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ khams gsum ris drug gi sems can kun gyi sdig sgrib sdug bsngal bsam/ slar 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus nas hrīḥyig la thim ma thag de nyid gnas 'gyur te/ khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar dwangs shing 'od du 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng du 'chi med bdud rtsi'i

46)bum pa 'dzin zhing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i kyil krung gis bzhugs pa ni 'dzum mtshan dpe'i phung po lta bas mi ngom pa'i sku la rin po che sna tshogs kyi dbu rgyan thor tshugs rtse bran dang*/ snyan cha mgur mchu phyag zhabs kyi bdu bu do shal ske rag sogs kyi rgyan dang lha'i dar zab kha dog sna tshogs pa'i na bza' la sogs longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs mtha' bdag yongs su rdzogs shing*/ ye shes 'od lnga'i phung po rnam par 'khrig pa'i klong na snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od mdangs ltar 'bar ba zhig tu gyur pa'i ting 'dzin brtan po mdzad par zhu/ 'di skabs gter gzhung gi dbang chog nyid du slob ma lhar gsal ba dang ye shes dbab pa sogs kyi gsal kham gsungs kyang bla med spyi dang*/ khyad par gter chos kyi dbang gzhung thams cad kyi dgongs don thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ med mi rung gi skabs don dbang gi snying po yin phyir 'di ltar bris pa lags/ ༈ de nas 47) rdo rje slob dpon las slob 'khor bcas kyis rol me spel dang tshe mda' dar sna btags pa'i g.yab rdzas sogs ye shes 'bebs pa'i yo byad thams cad langs te dbyangs snyan po dang ldan pas byin 'bebs bya ba'i khrabs su chud pa dang slob dpon gyis dmigs pa 'di ltar sprad de/ de nas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs gnas gsum dang*/ bdag nyid rdo rje slob dpohan gyi gnang gsum 'bru gsum gyi 'od zer dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyang tshe dpag med kyi skur gsal ba'i spyi bor ye shes oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ mthing ga res mtshan pa las kyang las ba'i thugs rje bskul ba'i dad pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ phyogs dus kyis rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje'i bdag nyid rnams dang rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro tshe la bdang ba'i drang srong rig 'dzin chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang*/

48)bcas pa thams cad mi mngon dbyings nas brtse ba chen pos dgongs te mdun gyis bar snang 'di nyid du sprin thib pa bzhin byon pa'i mos pa dang dad gdungs kyi shugs bskyes de gsol ba gdab pa la 'bad par mdzod la yid gzhan du yongs par mdzad cig hrīḥ sngon tshe skal pa'i dang po las/ 'chi med chos 'di su yis sgrub/ sgrub pa'i gnas mchog gang du yin/ dngos grub snying po su yis brnyes/ bcom ldan snang mtha' yab yum gyi/ bde chen 'bar ba'i zhing khams su/ skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub thob/ bgres rgud med pa'i grub rtags brnyes/ de yi byin rlabs dus 'dir stsol/ hrīḥ rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje dang*/ mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo yis/ ri bo chen po dān+tig tu/ skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub thob/ bgres rgud med 49)pa'i dongs grub rtags brnyes/ de yis byin rlabs dus 'dir stsol/ rig 'dzin shrī sing ha dang*/ mkha' 'gro rin chen zhi ba 'chos/ so za gling gi dur khrod du/ skye 'chi med= bgres rgud med= de yi byin rlabs= tshe bdag pad+ma thod phreng dang*/ mkha' 'gro lha lcam man+dha ras/ brag phug ma ra ti ka ru/ skye 'chi= bgres rgud= de yi= paṇa chen bi ma= mi dra dang*/ mkha' 'gro dbyings phyug rgyal mo yis/ lhun grub gtor gyi dur khrod du/ skye 'chi= bgres rgud= de yi= slob dpon hūm̐ chen ka ra dang*/ bram ze bu mo bde ldan mas/ brag dmar bya khyung sgrub gnas su/ skye= bgres= de yi= gnubs ban= nam mkha' snying po dang*/ mkha' 'gro shel dkar rdo rje mtshos/ lho brag mkhar chu'i dben gnas su/ skye= bgres= de yi= 50)myang man ting 'dzin bzang po dang*/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis/ bsam yas brag dmar ke tshang du/ skye= bgres= de yi= hrīḥ sngon dus che yi khungs re bzang*/ da lta tshe yi dpal re 'du/ bcom ldan tshe yi lha tshogs rnams/ sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer 'gyed/

snod bcu dngos grub thams cad bsdus/ thugs dam dus babs sa ma yā/ spros pas khams gsum bkrag mdangs ldan/ bsdus pas lus la gzi mdangs 'bar/ bcings pas rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ brtan pas mi 'gyur rdo rje 'dra/ skal ldan bu la byin chen phob/ las can 'di ma dngos grub stsol/ bla ma'i lha tshogs 'ja' 'od 'thib/ yi dam lha tshogs 'od zer 'khrug mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs bro brdungs ldir/ chos skyongs lha tshogs gar nyams khyug 'gro don mkha' khyab smin grol mdzod/ 51)mos pa'i bu la lung ston 'tshal/ bka' yis srung ma thams cad kyis/ rgyud 'dzin bu la gdong grogs mdzod/ ༈ de ltar byin chen dbab cing gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs de dag mus pa khyed rang dam tshig sems dpa' la mtsho la kha ba babs pa ltar sib kyi thim pas lus ngag yid gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo gyur pa'i nges shes brtan po gnang ba zhu/

zhes brjod 'das/ slob dpon gyi kyang ting 'dzin rtse gcig pas me tog la rtsa sngags dang rten 'brel snying pos rab tu gnas pa 'thor zhing rol mo drag tu sbir la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+t+ri te ye swā hā/ oṃ bh+rum̐ tram̐ hrīḥ mum̐ lam̐ mām̐ pyam̐ tām̐/ mum̐ hrīḥhūm̐ aḥ puṣ+pe dhu pe ā lo 52)ke gha b+dhe/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ sam̐ ho/ ā we sha ya āḥ.aḥ kā ya wañci t+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ zhes pas ye shes dbab cing brtan par bya'o/ ༈ de ltar ye shes kyi lha bstim zhing dam ye dbyer med du bsres pa de nyid dbang gi dngos gzhi gang yin la/ gzhi rdzogs mtha' rten gyin yan lag dang bcas pa bskur ba'i snod ldan du byas pa'i cha nas ni khyad par gyi sta gon du yang 'gyur ba grub nas da ni lus ngag yid gsum shes bya'i grib pa dang bzhi po gnas su dag par bya ba dang*/ lus lha/ ngag sngags/ sems chos nyid/ gang shar ye shes chen por nyams su blang ba'i skal ba rgyud la 'jog pa dang*/ chos longs sprul gsum ngo bo nyid bde ba chen po dang bcas te 'bras bu sku bzhi 'grub pa'i rten 'brel gyi sa bon bskun pa dang bcas pa'i don phyir dbang bzhi rim can 53)du bskur ba yin pas na/ thog mar lus smin par byed pa bum pa'i dbang bskur ba'i yul ni khyed rang rnams tshe dpag med kyi sku'i rnam pa dam ye dbyer med nyid la/ dbang bskur ba'i mkhan po ni dkyil 'khor mnga' bdag rdo rje slob dpon tshe dpag med pa'i ngo bor gnas gyur pa/ dbang bskur ba'i rdzas kyi dngos po yang mtshon byed brda rtags kyi bum gzugs la nang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyu+i bum bcud che lha gtso 'khor gyi pho brang 'di nyid spyi bor bzhag ma thag lha tshogs rnams kyi sku'i tsha thams cad nas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug tshangs bug tu zhugs nas lus thams cad mer gyi khengs pas 'chi med rdo rje'i sku 'grub pa'i nges shes mdzad par zhu/

dbus kyi gtso bum 'thogs la/ hrīḥ bkra shis bum pa lha yi gzhal yas khang*/ 54)phyi nang dbyer med 'od klong 'ja' zer 'khyim/ bcom ldan mgon po che yi lha tshogs bzhugs/ rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku yi dbang thob shog kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ zhes bum dbang spyi bor bskur zhing rol mo bsgrags/ me tog 'thor la/ de ltar bum dbang lta bus la bskur bas lus sgrib dag nas yi shig rdo rje lta bu'i sku thob par gyur cig de nas yang phyi mtshon byed rdzas kyi dngos po mtshan ldan kā pa la'i rnam pa la/ nang mtshon don bcud kyi ngo bo tshe lha yab yum bde sbyor lhan skyes kyi byang sems bdud rtsis gang ba mgrin par bzhag cing byin pas/ rtsa khams ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gyur zhing bde stong zag med gsang dbang gi ye shes rgyud la skye ba'i nges shes mdzad 'tshal/ hrīḥ dung chen snod du bdud rtsi sman gyis bkang*/ bcom ldan yab yum 55)byang sems dkar dmar rdzas/ thabs shes dbyer med byang chub sems kyi bcud/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas/ 'gags med tshang dbyangs gsung gi dbang thob shog wāka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes/ thos pa bdud rtsis mgrin par bskur zhing me tog 'thor te/ de ltar gsang dbang ngag la bskur bas ngag sgrib dag cing 'gag med tshang dbyangs lta bu'i gsung thob par gyur cig ༈ de nas yang mtshon byed dpe'i gzugs brnyan me long zlum po'i rnam pa la/ mtshon don chos sku thig le nyag gcig gsal la ngos bzung bral ba'i rtags kyi dbang snying gar bskur bas/ rig stong chos sku spros dang bral ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang don rgyud la skyes pa'i nges shes mdzad 'tshal/ hrīḥ ye shes lnga ldan me long dri bral 'di/ gsal zhing dag 56)la snyog bral stong gsal ngang*/ phyi nang zung 'jug gnyis med bsam brjod 'das/

tha dad ma yin gcig tu'ang grub pa med/ mtha' bral 'khrul med thugs kyi dbang thog shog tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes/ me long snying gar bzhag cing me tog 'thor te/ de ltar sher dbang sems la bskur bas hayid sgrib dag nas 'khrul med ye shes macog gi thugs thob par gyur cig de nas yang mtshon byed rdzas kyi dngos po ni gtor ma gzugs rgyan dang ldan pa la/ mtshon bya don gyi ngo bo ni tshe lha gtso 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs gnas lnga dbang bskur bas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du rgyas thebs shing tshig dbang rin po che don gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i nges shes mdzad par zhu/ hrīḥ phyi ltar bdud rtsi'i gtor ma sman las grub/ nang ltar rin chen rdzas mchog nyi shu lnga/ gsang bar dmigs pa'i ting 'dzin 57)'phro 'du gsal/ de ni rigs 'dus tshe dpag med pa'i dbang*/ tshe yid dngos grub dam pa thob par shog sarba a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ zhes/ gtor ma spyi mgrin snying lte gsang ba lngar bzhag cing*/ me tog 'thor la/ de ltar gtor dbang gnas lngar bskur bas gzung 'dzin shes sgrib thams cad dag nas sku bzhi dbyer med kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig dbang bsdus pa byed na 'di yan chad kyis kyang chog cing*/ 'dir ni rgyas par bskur ba'i tshul bshad pa yin phyir gter gzhung nyid dkyi lugs bzhin rtog te/ ༈ de ltar bla med kyi dbang bzhi po 'dir ma 'dus pa'am tshang ba zhig med na'ang*/ slar yang nang nus pa'i dbang ngam/ rjes gnang brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi tshul dang mthan par/ sku phyag rgya'i dbang*/ gsung gi snying po'i dbang*/ thugs rig pa rtsal gyi dbang dang bcas pa bskur ba yin pas 58)na/ thog mar lha sku phyag rgya'i dbang la khyed rang rnams sngar bzhin mgon po che dpag med kyi skur gsal ba las ma g.yos pa'i ngang nas/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor nas che bdag rgyal ba rigs lnga rnams kyi sku las rang 'dra'i ye shes 'od kyi sku re mar me gcig las gnyis mched ltar 'phros nas khyed rang rnams kyi gnas lnga so sor thim pas/

nyon mongs dug lnga'i bag chags dbyings su dag cing ye shes lnga mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa brtan po mdzad par zhu/ gtso mchog gi sku dang dbus kyi gtso bum lhan cig 'thogs nas/ hrīḥsku sprul rnam par snang mdzad tshe dpag med/ gnyis med ma spangs chos dbyings ye shes dang*/ sku mdog dkar gsal 'khor lo tshe bum 'dzin skal ldan bu yi spyi bor zhugs thim nas/ mi 'gyur g.yu drung lta bu'i sku thob shog oṃ bud+dha a yu ṣe a bhi 59)ṣiñca oṃ/ zhes spyi bor bskur/ ༈ de nas pad+ma tshe dpag med kyi sku dang nub kyi bum pa 'thogs la/ hrīḥgasung sprul snang ba mthu rgyas tshe dpag med/ 'dod chags ma spangs por rtog ye shes ngang*/ sku mdog dmar gsal pad+ma tshe bum 'dzin/ skal ldan bu yi mgrin par zhugs thim nas/ grags stong tshangs dbyangs lta bu'i dbang thob shog hrīḥpad+ma ā yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ zhes mgrin par bskur ro/ badz+ra tshe dpag med kyi sku dang shar bum 'thogs la/ hrīḥthugs sprul rdo rje sems dpa' tshe dpag med/ zhe sdang ma spangs me long ye shes ngang*/ sku mdog mthing gsal rdo rje bum 'dzin/ skal ldan bu yis snying gar zhugs thim pas/ mi shig rdo rje lta bu'i dbang thob shog hūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes/ snying gar sbyar ro/ rat+na tshe dpag med kyi sku dang lho bum 'thogs la/ hrīḥyon tan sprul pa rin 60)'byung tshe dpag med/ nga rgyal ma spangs mnyam nyid ye shes ngang*/ sku mdog ser gsal rin chen che bum 'dzin/ skal ldan bu yi lte bar zhugs thim nas/ mi nub rgyal mtshan lta bu'i dbang thob shog tram̐ rat+na a yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñca tram̐/ zhes lte bar bskur ro/ karma tshe dpag med kyi sku dang byang bum 'thegs la/ hrīḥ phrin las sprul pa don grub tshe dpag med/ phrag dog ma spangs bya grub ye shes ngang*/ sku mdog ljang gsal rgya gram tshe labum 'dzin/

skal ldan bu yi gsang bar zhugs thim nas/ phrin las 'gro 'dul tshe yi dbang thob shog aḥkarma a yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñca aḥ zhes gsang gnas su bskur ro/ 'di la snga gong du dbus kyi gtso bo dang nub kyi gtso bo bzhugs pa go brjes pa dang 'dir ma brjes sal dang tha dad par byung ba 'gal bar mi lta ste/ gong ma ni dkyil 'khor rigs gang gtso'i khyad don yin zhing*/ skabs 'dir ni spyi 'gro ltar gyi sku lnga ye shes 61) lnga'i dag sbyor yin pa'i gnang de/ ༈ de nas yum lnga'i sku 'thogs la/ de nas yang dkyil 'khor nas rigs kyi yum mchog lngas rang 'dra'i sku re spros te khyed cag la thim pas/ 'byung lnga khams lnga dbang shes lnga'i 'jin rtogs gnas su ga nas gsal stong 'dzin med kyi don mngon du gyur pa'i nges shes mdzad par zhu/ hrīḥ skal ldan las can rigs kyi bu rnams la/ gos dkar spyan ma mā ki dbyings phyug sgrol/ tshe yi yum mchog lnga yis dbang bskur bas/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rang bzhin bram/ 'chi med gsal stong 'dzin med dbang thob shog yum̐ lam̐ mam̐ pyam̐ hām̐ a yu ṣi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes spyi bor bskur ro/ de nas rigs bzhi po'i sku 'thogs la/ yang dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhi nas sprul pa rnam pa bzhi las so so rang 'dra'i sku 'phros nas khyed rang rnams la thim pas ma rig las 62)nyon gyi sgrib tshogs dag nas/ 'jam dbyangs kyi mkhyen rab/ spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje/ phyag rdor gyi mthu stobs pad 'byung gi byin rlabs nus pa thams cad khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la 'jags pa'i mos pa gnang 'tshal/ hrīḥ skal ldan las can rigs kyi bu rnams la/ 'jam dbyangs spyan ras spyan gzigs phyag rdor pad 'byung gi mkhyen brtse nus pa byin rlabs kun zhugs nas/ 'gro don thog med srid gsum zil gyis gnon/ skye 'chi med pa tshe yi dbang thob shog dhīḥhrīḥhūm̐ aḥ.a yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/

zhes spyi bo thogs gsum du bskur ro/ lha mo bzhi'i sku thogs la/ yang dkyil 'khor gyi mtshams bzhi nas tshe'i las byed kyi lha mo mgyogs byed bzhi las rang 'dra'i sku 'phros te khyed cag la thim pas/ rtags chad mu bzhi gnas su dag nas dga' bzhi'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i 63)mos pa mdzod/ hrīḥ skal ldan las can rigs kyi bu rnams la/ lha mo mgyogs ma bzhi yi dbang bskur bas/ puṣ+pe dhu pe a lo ke gan+dhe mas/ dbang bskur byin rlabs rtag chad gnyis 'dzin bral/ a 'thas 'khrul pa ka nas dag par shog puṣ+pe dhu pe a lo ke gan+dha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes spyi bo'am snying gar bskur ro/ sgo ba yab yum brgyad kyi sku 'tshogs la/ de nas yang dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi nas sgo ba yab yum rnams las rang 'dra'i sku 'phros nas khyed rang rnams la thib pas/ bdag gzhan chags sdang gi rtogs tshogs dbyings su grol zhing skye ba rnam bzhi rgyun chod de/ tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro don 'grub pa'i nus ldan du nges shes mdzad par zhu/ hrīḥ skal ldan las can rigs kyi bu rnams la/ rnam rgyal gshin rje rta mgrin 64)bdud rtsid 'khyil/ lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril 'khrol ma/ sgo ba yab yum brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas/ skye ba rnam bzhi len pa'i sgo chod cig hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes spyi bo'am yan lag bzhi pa bskur ro/ de ltar lha sku phyag rgya'i dbang gis lus phung khams skye mched lha'i rang bzhin du byin rlabs nas/ de nas gsang sngags kyi rang bzhin du byas pa'i phyir bla mtshe dpag med pa dngos su mos ྃ'i ljags kyi 'od zer gzungs sngags yig 'bru'i tshogs pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba lta bu 'phros pa khyed rang rnams kyi lce la thim pa tsam gyis/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag nyes tshogs ma lus pa byang zhing dag nas/ dbugs 'byin 'jug gnas gsum dang ngag gi smra brjod thams cad sngags kyi rang bzhin 'ba' zhig tu rgyas theb par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzad par zhu/

tshe gzungs kyi sngags byang dang 'phreng ba 'thogs la/ hrīḥskal ldan 65)las can rigs kyi bu rnams la/ gzungs sngags rgyal po gsang ba'i yang snying 'di/ sngags dbang ngag la bskur bas ngag sgrib dag grags stog chu bo'i rgyun ltar bzla bar gyis/ nus ldan rdo rje'i sngags kyi dbang thob shog oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzi wan+ti ye swā ha/ zhes pa'i gzungs thung dang 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs ri sogs kyi bzlas lung byin zhing*/ dbang rdzas mgrin par bzhag cing dbang bskur ro/ de ltar sngags dbang ngag la bskur bas ngag r+yagal ba'i gsung gi 'khor lor byin rlabs nas/ da ni rig pa rtsal gyi dbang sems la bskur phyir dbyings stong pa nyid mtshon pa'i me long g.ya' bral la gsal mdangs 'gags med mtshon pa'i rma bya'i mdong 'od shar ba snang stong zung 'jug gi brda don gyi dbang bskur bas/ dbyings rig dbyer med 'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa'i don mngon du gyur pa'i nges shes 66)mdzod cig me long rma bya'i mdongs 'thogs la/ hrīḥ skal ldan las can rigs kyi bu rnams la/ rang gsal rang 'od rma bya'i mdongs 'od 'di/ khyed la bstan pas gnyis 'dzin dbyings su dag bsgom bya sgom byed mthong mkhan sems su grol/ dbyings rig gnyis su med pa'i dbang thob shog bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣīñca hūm̐/ zhes bstan cing snying gar btug go de nas slar yang dbang don ngo sprad do/ 'o skal ba dang ldan pa rigs kyi bu rnams nam mkha' dri ma med pa'i mtha' dbus la ltos dang*/ sems nyid mtha' dbus bral ba nam mkha' lta bur shes par gyis shig shar lho nub byang la 'gyu ba gang shar thong dang*/ btang mkhan dag 'gyu mkhan tha dad med pa'i 'tshang rigs par gyis shig phyag mtshan rdo rje bstan nas/ rdo rje 'di la lta mkhan gang yin pa rtogs cig gzugs snang lam me ba'i shes pa nyid las gzhan pa'i blta bya blta 67)byed med do/ dril bu sil ma/

dril bu'i sgra 'di gang nas byung*/ gang du thim/ mtha' rjes chod dang*/ sems nyid 'gag med kyi rtsal mdangs dril bu'i sgrar shar ba nyid las gzhan ma yin no/ des na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang rig chos kyi sku thig le nyag gcig ye thog dang po'i shes pa bzo bcos ma byas pa 'di ka 'chi med rdo rje mgon po tshe dpag med pa mngon sum du gtan la phab pa yin pas na/ yin lugs ngo shes par gyis cig de'i rang bzhin rang mdangs gsal cha ma 'gags pa 'od lngar shar ba ni 'chi med rgyal ba rigs lnga'o/ de'i rang rtsal yum lnga 'byung ba lnga'o/ de'i rigs rtsal gyi rnam par 'phrul par rigs gsum mgon po dang gu ru pad+ma/ snang cha'i bye brag kun brtag tsam du mgyogs ma bzhi/ dran pa'i so ma nyams pa ni sgo ba yab yum 68)brgyad de/ de thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gcig tu lhun gyis grub pa'i rang sems gcig char 'di kho na la sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas zhes ming tsam brda tsam du btags so/ snang ba mtha' yas zhes pa'i don yang*/ snang ba'i ngo bo ni stong pa nyid yin la/ stong pa'i rang mdangs snang ba yin te/ snang stong gnyis tha dad kyang ma yin gcig tu'ang ma grub cing snang la a 'thas su mi 'dzin pa'i rang ngo rig pa las sangs rgyas zhes kyang bya/ chos sku zhes bya/ snang ba mthas yas zhes kyang ba yin la/ de ltar rtogs tshe skye 'chi ye nas ma byung ma skyes pa'i phyir sangs rgyas tshe dpag tu med pa ces pa'i don gyi ngo bo ni de yin no/ dbang thams cad kyi snying po rig pa rtsal gyi dbang yang 'di yin no/ 'di lta bu'i don sems la shar na gsang sngags kyi dbang thams cad gcig rdzogs su thob pa'i phyir tshig dbang rin po che mthar thug don gyi yang bcud 69)'di yin pas de ltar shes par mdzod cig de nas rjes mtha' rten gyi dbang bskur ba'i dang po bum pa lnga po'i dbus kyi gtso bum 'thogs na/

de ltar btsom ldan 'das tshe dpag med kyi rtsa ba'i dbang bskur ma lus yongs rdzogs su grub nas/ da ni jares mtha' rten yan lag gi dbang rnams 'bul ba la/ thog mar bum pa'i yon tan gyi cha shas dang bum rdzas tha dad pa'i nus pa mtha' dag bskur tshig dag mthun pa'i byin rlabs dang yon tan khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la skyes shing smin pa'i nges shes mdzad par zhu/ hrīḥ las can skal ldan rigs kyi mu rnams la/ bum pa dkar ser dmar ljang mthing 'od 'bar/ ngo bo lha la rma pa bum pa'i tshul/ gsal stong gnyis med bdud rtsi'i chu yis bkangs/ bkra shis rin chen bum lngas dbang bskur bas/ dri zhim spos kyi tshad pa'i gdung sel 70)ltar/ tshad med bzhi ldan zag med bdud rtsi lnga/ nyon mongs dug lnga'i sdug bsngal sel bar shog oṃ bh+rum̐ tram̐ hrīḥ.aḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/

zhes spyi bor bskur ba'i mthar/ skal ldan rnams la dbus kyi bdud rtsi lnga'i bum pas dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa dug lnga rang sar grol ba'i dbang thob par gyur cig shar bum 'thogs la/ hrīḥ sman mchog dbang lag tu ta sle tres dang*/ shu dag dkar po kaṇ+ṭa kā ri lngas/ rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus 'khrug nas rnams sel/ nad 'joms chos nyid rab tu bsten par shog bhai ṣa dz+ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes bskur la/ skal ldan rnams la sman lnga'i bum pas dbang bskur bas bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi rgyu 'bras kyi nad kun zhi ba'i dbang thob par gyur cig lho nub 'thogs la/ hrīḥ gser dngul mu tig mu men byu ru lnga/ yid bzhin nor bus re ba kun bskong 71)ltar/ 'gro don bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ yon tan re ba skong ba'i dbang thob shog rat+na sarba a bhi ṣīñca hūm̐/ skal ldan rnams la rin chen lngī bum pas dbang bskur bas 'gro ba'i 'dod dgu yid bzhin du stsol ba'i dbang thob par gyur cig nub bum 'thogs la/ hrīḥ dri mchog dza ti tsan+dan dkar dmar dang*/ ga bur gur kum dri lngas dbang bskur bas/ ma rig las ngan sdug bsngal dag gyur cing*/ zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las kun 'grub shog shin+taṃ puṣ+ṭaṃ wa sham mā ra ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ skal ldan rnams la dri lnga'i bum pas dbang bskur bas/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig byang bum 'thogs la/ hrīḥ'abru sna nas 'bras gro til mon sran lnga/ ka ra sbrang rtsi 'o ma zho dang mar/ 'bru sna snying po lnga yi dbang bskur bas/ dge bcu lhun gyis grub pa'i 72)thob shog hṛ dang ya sarba a bhi ṣīñca hūm̐/ skal ldan rnams la 'bru lnga snying po lnga'i bum pas dbang bskur bas/ 'gro ba'i dbul ba sel ba'i dbang thob par gyur cig zhes bskur nas/ slar yang gtso bum 'thogs nas/ hrīḥ mgul chings cod pan dar sna lnga yi dbang*/ nyon mongs dug lnga ye shes lnga ru gyur/

zhing khams lnga rdzogs yon tan lnga dang ldan/ khams gsum dbang du 'du ba'i dbang thob shog wa sham ku ru a bhi ṣīñca hūm̐/ hrīḥ kha brgyan 'bras bu dpag bsam shing gi dbang*/ yid bzhin nor bu lta bur re 'dod skong*/ 'gro don thog med dgos 'dod lhun gyis grub/ khams gsum 'gro kun smin cing grol bar shog oṃ āḥhūm̐ a bhi ṣīñca dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ zhes bskur zhing bum pa bzhi po'i tsho gtso bum du cung zad re bsdongs nas slob ma la byin no/ ༈ de nas tshe ril sbyin zhing*/ hrīḥ phyi nang dam rdzas bdud rtsi sman las grub/ ril 73)bu 'di nyid zos pas myong grol mchog phyi yi gdon zhi nang gi nad rnams sel/ the tshom yid gnyis med par longs spyod cig oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ tshe chang sbyin la/ hrīḥrtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a mṛ ta/ bcom ldan yab yum byang sems 'di thungs pas/ stong phrag bdu cu rtsa gnyis rtsa 'dab grol/ rlung sems dbu ma'i klong du grol bar shog oṃ ma mṛ ta ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dngos grub kyis zas sna sna tshogs lag tu gtad nas/ hrīḥyi ge bh+rum las 'dod yon bsam mi khyab/ ro mchog bcud ldan gza' btung longs spyod 'di/ ci bsam lhun grub 'dod dgu'i re ba skongs/ mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang thob shog oṃ badz+ra bh+rum̐ a yu ṣe swā hā/ dar zas gos kyi rigs sna tshogs gtad la/ hrīḥ reg 'jam sna tshogs lha hayis na bza' 'di/ bsod nams las grub phya g.yang byin 'od 74)ldan/ skye ba 'di dag tshe rab kun tu yang*/ tsha grang skyob byed na bza'i dbang thob shog oṃ badz+ra spa r+she ā yu ṣe ā hūm̐/ bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad rnams lus kyi gnas so sor btug cing rgyas btab la/ hrīḥ skal ldan mul rtags brgyad dbang bskur bas/ dbu la bkra shis gdugs kyi tsha gdung skyobs/ snu la bkra shis mi nub rgyal mtshan 'bar/ gsung la bkra shis dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil/

thugs la bkra shigs dpal gyi be'u bkra/ ljags la bkra shis pad+mo le 'dab rgyas/ spyan la bkra shis gser nya 'od zer 'khrug mgul la bkra shis rin chen bum pa ldir/ phyag zhabs bkra shis 'khor lo rtsibs stong bskor/ rtags brgyad bkra shis dbang mchog thob par shog oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe aṣ+ṭa maṃ ga la a bhi ṣīñca hūm̐/ zhes bskur zhing*/ tshe'i sgrub chen sogs shin tu rgyas par spron skabs 'dir zhi khro nges don nas 'byung ba ltar bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyan dang rgyal srid rin chen bdun gyis dbang rnams kyang 75) bya'o/ de nas slob ma spyi tsam la ni 'di nas dbang zhabs bsdu ba rgyas gdab dang bcas pa bya zhing*/ gal te slob ma chos kyi kun 'dzin gzhan don nus pa dag yin na rdo rje slob dpon du mnga' gsol zhing chos kyi gnyer gtad phyir/ seng ge'i khri la slob ma de nid bzhag cing*/ steng nas gdugs dang bla bres 'bus pa dang*/ yol ba dar 'chan rgyal mtshan sogs bkram/ dbang gzhu 'dab ldan rigs lnga dang dbang gos sogs gsol/ rdor dril lag tu gtad/ spes sogs mchod pa dang rol mo sna tshogs bsgrag cing*/ chos bka' yongs rdzogs kyi glegs bam lag tu gtad pa dag bcas pas mnga' gsol zhing*/ dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i skyed rim gsal du bcug la/ hrīḥrigs kyi bu khyod ma 'ong dus su yang*/ makyab skyed 'gro yongs la chos ston cing*/ tshe dpag med pa mngon sum lhun gyis grub/ khams gsum spyi dpal rigs 'dus dbang thob shog oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe sarba dharma a bhi ṣīñca hūm̐/ hrīḥ gzhan yang 'khor 'das snod bcud 'khor yug tu 76)deng nas srid gsum bag por mnga' gsol gyi/ dkyil 'khor yong rdzogs lhun gyis grub pa yi/ phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang rdzogs thob par shog sarba wa sham ku ru a bhi ṣīñca hūm̐/ zhes chos bka' gtad cing bkra shis rab gnas kyang bya'o/ de ltar dbang rgyas bsdus gang brtar bskur yang mjug sdud mtha' rten dpang zhabs bskul ni/

gtso bum/ thod pa/ gtor ma gsum po mkhar gzhong sogs su gdan drangs pa slob ma'i gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ hrīḥ skal ldan las can rigs kyi bu rnams la/ 'dod yon rmad byung gtor ma'i dbang mchog rdzas/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bum pa kā pa la/ rnam dag gsang ba'i dbang mchog 'di bskur bas/ skye 'chi gnyis med rang bzhin dbang thob shog oṃ āḥhūm̐ ka ya wak+tsit+ta a bhi dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes dbang bskur ba'i mthar/ 'di ltar yongs rdzogs mtha' rten gyi dbang bskur bas dbang rdzas 77)rnams kyi lha tshogs 'od du zhu nas lnga ldan thig le'i rnam par gyur pa khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim pas tshe dpag med kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs gzi mdangs tshe dpal mkhyen rtse nus stobs sogs mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus rtsal sprugs su thob pa'i nges shes dang mi 'bral ba mdzad 'tshal lo/ de ltar dbang rnams rdzogs pa'i mthar 'chi med rgyas gdab kyi rab gnas bya ba ni/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu dang lhan cig tshe mda' dar sna dang bla srog gi rten rdzas tshang bar btags pa thogs nas rgyas 'debs kyi tshig dag mthun par slob ma'i spyi bo sogs lus kyi gsanas rnams su bya pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ rol mo dbyangs dang ldan pas thog mar rgyas gdab pa'i dmigs pa 'di ltar sprad te/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi tshe dang bla srog bkrag mdangs gzi brjid mthu stobs dbang thang sogs bskyed cing bstim pa de dang rkyen gyis mi 'jig cing 78)mi nyams par bya ba'i phyir byin rlabs 'gyur med kyi rgyas btab dgos pas na/ 'chi med grub pa'i gta' ru bzung ba'i rjes rdzas kyi tshe mda' 'di las 'od zer rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud du 'phros pa khyed rang rnams la phog pas lus thams cad ye shes kyi rdo rje'i go khrab kyis bar 'tshams med par g.yogs shig btams te/

phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad 'gal rkyen bar chad gang gis kyang glag mi snyed par gyur pa'i mos pa gnang bar zhu/ hrīḥ dkyil 'khor chen mo'i lha tshogs rnams/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad ris med nas gang gi tshe nyams 'dir bsdus shig tshe gta' gnyan po mi la bstim/ mi dang tshe gnyis kam bral zhig hrīḥ sngon dus bskal pa'i thog ma la/ 'ogan min sdug bod bkod pa ru/ mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba'i tshe/ zhing mchog chos dbyings pho brang nang 79)drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi tshe/ nub phyogs bde chen pho brang na/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas tshe/ shar phyogs ri bo tā la na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi tshe/ spros pas khams gsum bkrag mdangs ldan/ bsdus pas lus la gzi mdangs 'bar/ bcings pas rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud/ skal ldan rnams la dngos grub stsol/ khyed kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ hrīḥ de nas bar gyi bskal pa la/ ma ra ti ka'i yang dben du/ rig 'dzin pad+ma yab yum la/ tshe dpag med pa dngos su byon/ skye 'chi med par dbang yang bskur/ bgres rgud med pa'i dngos grub thob/ khyed kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ hrīḥ ma 'ong bskal dus snyigs ma la kong yul ljon pa'i nags tshal du/ sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag mo 'bar la/ bdag 'dra pad+mas byin gyis rlabs/ 'chi med 80)chos kyi dngos grub thob/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ sgrub mchog tshe yi dngos grub 'di/ 'byung ba lnga la sba srid na/ des kyang mi thub a tir sba/ chos kyi dbyings su tshe sbas pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas dgrar langs kyang*/ de la bzung zhing 'jig pa med/ gnyis med zung 'a'ajug rang bzhin la/ sba sri ma dgos ye rgyas btab/ g.yu drung rgyal mtshan rdo rje'i tshe/ spros pas stong gsum bkrag mdangs bsrungs pas 'dul la gzi byin skyed/ bcings pas rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud/ snying po lnga bsdus rdzas kyi mchog deg 'dir lus ngag yid gsum la/

'khor gsum yongs dag tshe sba'o/ rgyas btab bcol lo thub par srungs/ khro bo bcu dang longs spyod bcud/ tshe 'di srungs cig srog gta' sdoms/ bkrag bzang dbyangs snyan dran pa gsal/ tshe yel bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas/ mi nor chos kyi dngos grub stsol/ 81)bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyas btab po/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad rgyas gdab po/ yig 'bru lnga yi rgyas gdab po/ phyag mtshan lnga yi rgyas gdab po/ 'gyur ba med pa'i sku thob shog skye 'chi med pa'i don rtogs shog oṃ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma bud+dha ā yu ṣe nṛ dzaḥ aḥ.aḥ.aḥ zhes rgyas 'debs byas ba'i rjes pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das tshe'i lha tshogs rnams kyis khyed rang rnams la bden tshig bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs sgrogs cing shis brjod me tog gi char chen dbab pa'i mos pa mdzod cig ces brjod la shis brjod rab gnas rgyas par bya'o/ de gas sku drin btang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang tshogs mchod/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor lha la btang rag bkod gsol bsngo smon bkra shis dang*/ ye shes gshegs cing dam tshig pa bsdu ba sogs rjes chog thams cad spyi gzhung ltar bya'o/ de ltar 'di ni shin tu rgyas pa'i 82) lugs su bya tshul yin la/ bsdus par byed na/ dbang bshad ci rigs dag skyabs sems gsol ba mdor bsdus byas pa'i 'phror ye shes dbab cing bstim mthar/ bum thod me long gtor ma dang bzhi'i dbang bskur nas tshe chu thod chang tshe ril byin pa'i mjug tu mda' dar 'thogs nas dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs rnams/ zhes pa'i tshig rkang lnga'i 'phror/ g.yu drung rgyal mtshan rdo rje'i tshe/ zhes pa man chad kyi rgyas gdab la shis pa brjod pas chog pa'o/ tshe sgrub gnam lcags rdo rje'i dngos grub mchog sprul pa'i sku bzang pa'i mtshan 'chang ba gang gi bka'i bdud rtsi'i bcud bzang snying la yang dag sim pa'i mthus/ sna tshogs rang grol gyi btsun pas dpal ri gangs kyi lho phyogs bde gshegs tshe'i phug tu zin ris su bkod pa'i dge bas mchog gi sprul pa'i sku de nyid sogs skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe 'phel ba dang*/
